question: ______ was launched in January 2021 to conceptualise innovative toys based on the Indian value system which will inculcate the positive behaviour and good value among the children.
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Toycathon__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Toycathon** **2021 **aimed to conceptualize modern toys primarily based totally on the Indian fee gadget with the purpose to inculcate superb behavior and desirable fee for many children. 
 
• Speaking at the occasion, Mr. Pokhriyal stated that Toycathon has been organized to expand India as the** worldwide toy production hub**. 
 
• He said the size of the toy market in India is about one billion USD but unfortunately **80** per cent of the toys are imported.
 
• The release of **Toycathon** is an endeavour with the aid of using the authorities to create an environment for the home Toy enterprise and the local manufacturers, tapping the untapped assets and utilizing their potential.
 
• Recalling the vision of** Prime Minister Narendra Modi **of a 5 trillion-dollar economy and considering the huge potential of our toy market, **Mr Nishank** exhorted all to make India **‘Atmanirbhar’** in the Toy industry. 
 
• The **Toycathon** will have 3 variants of tracks **Junior Level, Senior Level **and **Start-up Level** and will permit the participation of college students and instructors from schools, schools and universities aside from startups and toy experts. 
 
• Participants can have alternatives for concept submission, they are able to publish thoughts for the posted hassle statements or under the novel toy principles category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Code Gladiators**

 
 
• **Code Gladiators** is an annual coding opposition via way of means of **TechGig**, that attracts the quality and the brightest coding expertise from all elements of India. 
 
• With more than one contest in rising technology and the coveted identity of Code Gladiators up for grabs, the opposition sees enthusiastic participation and has grown from power to power with every passing year. 
 
 
 
• ** Great Indian Alexa Hackathon**
 
 
• **​****Amazon India** announced a partnership with Bengaluru-based talent management start-up** HackerEarth** for its first virtual **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** hackathon for **Alexa** in the country. 
 
• This precise hackathon is aimed toward constructing extra enticing talents for Alexa, that is the Cloud-primarily based totally **voice assistant**, consisting of **Amazon Echo.** 
 
 
 
• ** Smart India Hackathon**
 
 
• ​**Smart India Hackathon** is a national initiative to offer college students a platform to resolve a number of the urgent problems we are facing in our everyday lives, and hence inculcate a tradition of product innovation and a mindset of problem-solving. 
 
• The previous edition of the **hackathon** saw over 5 million+ students from various engineering colleges compete for the top prize at 35+ locations.
